name: wiki-sync
description: Nightly sync of ASTGL-tagged SecondBrain wiki pages (concepts, entities, syntheses) into knowledge.db. Incremental — only re-processes pages modified since last sync. Detects and retires orphaned pages whose source files were deleted or lost the astgl tag.
scheduleReadable: Every night at 00:30 (30min after draft pipeline)

preExec.description: Walk SecondBrain wiki dirs, filter for astgl tags, embed chunks via Ollama, upsert into knowledge.db with source_origin=secondbrain.

instructions: Review the JSON output: pages_synced, pages_skipped_unchanged, orphans_retired, chunks_created.
If orphans_retired > 0, verify the pages were intentionally deleted or re-tagged in SecondBrain.
If the Research volume was unmounted, the script exits cleanly with skipped=true — this is expected.
